Degree-preserving rewiring sensitivity test for graph TFCE

Source: R/leviNetworkStatistics.R
leviGraphTFCERewiring.Rd

Computes graph TFCE scores for fixed gene scores and compares them with the TFCE maxima obtained on degree-preserving rewired networks.

leviGraphTFCERewiring(
  scores,
  networkCoordinatesInput,
  networkInteractionsInput = NA,
  fileTypeInput = "dat",
  n_perm = 999L,
  rewire_steps = NULL,
  E = 0.5,
  H = 2,
  n_steps = 100L,
  seed = NULL,
  BPPARAM = SerialParam()
)

Arguments

scores

Named numeric vector of gene scores (for example moderated t-statistics or log fold-changes) indexed by gene identifier. Network nodes without a finite score are dropped before testing.

networkCoordinatesInput, networkInteractionsInput, fileTypeInput

LEVI network inputs: node coordinates, optional interactions and the file type accepted by [levi()].

n_perm

Number of rewired null networks.

rewire_steps

Number of degree-preserving edge swaps passed to [igraph::keeping_degseq()] for every null network. Defaults to ten times the number of edges (at least 10).

E, H

TFCE extent and height exponents applied to the component size and to the threshold height at every integration step.

n_steps

Number of threshold steps used to integrate the TFCE score between zero and the maximum statistic.

seed

Optional RNG seed.

BPPARAM

A [BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam] object controlling how the permutations are evaluated. The default runs them serially.

Value

A data frame with TFCE scores and degree-preserving rewiring P-values.

Examples

network <- data.frame(ID = c("A", "B", "C", "D"), X = 1:4, Y = 1:4)
edges <- data.frame(V1 = c("A", "B", "C", "D"), V2 = c("B", "C", "D", "A"))
leviGraphTFCERewiring(c(A = 3, B = 2.5, C = -1, D = -2), network, edges,
  fileTypeInput = "stg", n_perm = 9)
#>   Gene  TFCEOver TFCEUnder PRewireGlobal Significant
#> A    A 11.305705 0.0000000           0.6       FALSE
#> B    B  7.409713 0.0000000           1.0       FALSE
#> C    C  0.000000 0.4856409           1.0       FALSE
#> D    D  0.000000 2.8490409           1.0       FALSE
